title: Finance Budget Partner
full_description:
At ING we are looking for a Finance Budget Partner
Your role and work environment:
We are looking for aFinance Budget Partner to new segmentsto help us in our ambition to support the Bank’s growth and diversification achieving commercial and financial targets, while ensuring that we build towards the overall strategy.
You are the key representative from the Finance department in a cross-functional team with colleagues from business, operations and IT to contribute to the launch of new segments and have an impactful partnership with all our stakeholders. This means youfully understand the financial business case of the new segments(specifically Affluents, BuBa) withspecial focus on the management of the expenses and capacity budgetand use this to proactively propose and promote ideas to optimize resources and investments across the bank and bring our strategy into execution.
In your journey towards achieving this challenging target, you will have a global perspective and you will work on efficiency from a global point of view and from different perspectives: Culture, Governance & Way of Working, and Data Monitoring & Visibility.
In this role you are part of a small team (5 FTE) in the Management Accounting area, and besides your direct responsibilities you support your direct colleagues in their roles as Budget Partner to the new segments.
This will grant you with a dynamic environment, growth potential and the possibility to have real impact. You will receive close support and attention from your manager in the delivery of your duties and your professional development.

What are we looking for?
A strong set of technical and analytical abilities:
Master or bachelor’s degree (preferably in mathematics or engineering) with a minimum of 5 years of experience in a comparable role.
Full proficiency in Excel (PowerQuery), SAS and SQL.
Excellent speaking and writing skills in English is a must.
Strong analytical skills and problem-solving mindset.
Global vision. Strategic and creative thinker.
Ability to simplify complexity.
Early adopter to new technologies.
A leader of our Orange Code culture displays the following behaviors:
Excellent interpersonal skills (influencing and communication)
High level of autonomy and initiative.
Ability to work on an international level.
Able to assume personal responsibility.
High level of curiosity and eager to learn, stay on top of trends and developments within your field and the market.
Team player. Loving to collaborate with different people.
Results oriented. Make things happen.
Flexible to be able to adapt fast to the changes.
